findings.text: non-blocking: the collection guard is committed but no test exercises it, so a regression of the hook itself reddens nothing; logs/guard-refusal.log is a manual --collect-only run over test_zz_planted_graph_writer.py, which is not in the landed tree, so the demonstration is not repeatable by a later reader.

non-blocking: the guard reads only inspect.getsource(item.obj), the test function body, so a writer that delegates its write to a non-write-prefixed helper (populate, apply_rows) while holding a bare client escapes; the detector is a name-and-AST heuristic and misses indirection.

non-blocking: the log header names revision 4eb9902b6 and repeats the head-graph command while its body is a planted-writer collect-only run, so a reader who trusts the header reads the wrong revision and command for that evidence.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from base 6e9edb8bf to head aecc88921; three commits, four files, +314/-20, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for both gate arms, zero added failure ids and logged controls; the manifest names both arms and the control, and logs/base-graph.ids and logs/head-graph.ids are byte-identical at 18 failures each.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to route the five graph-marked writers in tests/graph to a disposable Neo4j and stop the hazard returning; tests/graph/conftest.py:269 defines disposable_graph and :395 defines the collection guard, and the two writer files request the fixture.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the reviewed run directory; status complete, four changed paths, the gate command, five log paths, the baseline and after arms, and the negative control naming the project URI are all recorded.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope was tests/graph/conftest.py, the two writer files, tests/conftest.py only if the fixture moved, and the evidence fragment; the diff touches the first three plus the fragment and never tests/conftest.py.

justifications.durability: a writer that loses its disposable fixture is refused at tests/graph/conftest.py:395, but no committed test exercises the hook itself, so deleting _writer_facts or the UsageError reddens nothing.

justifications.fit: the fixture and guard follow the mechanism-comment style of the surrounding tests/graph/conftest.py fixtures and carry no plan, ticket or author identifiers.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every writer test now takes disposable_graph or _disposable_gc (tests/graph/test_code_reference_links.py:28, tests/graph/test_dd_unit_correction_reconcile.py:178) and the guard at tests/graph/conftest.py:395 refuses a writer without it.
